_comment: Curiosity's HOST is a searched plan variant, and the loop starts from a cantrip in the same main phase. Mid-turn frame (resume_at main1, land drop spent): a SUMMONING-SICK Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind (it can neither attack nor tap to draw) beside a Goblin Guide, two Islands, and Curiosity + Preordain in hand. The only same-turn kill is Curiosity on the NIV (not the Guide), then Preordain: its draw pings, Curiosity draws, and the loop runs to 0. Curiosity on the Guide only draws off the Guide's combat damage (one card, one ping) -- no kill. Fails if the host stops being searched, if the cast's resolution stops flushing the draw triggers, or if Curiosity's damage->draw grant breaks.
